Title: MegaForm for Umbraco
Description: A complete visual form and application builder for Umbraco 13 through 18. Start quickly with 31 bundled QuickStart templates or the searchable Online Gallery with working template previews. Create and iteratively edit forms with AI using Google Gemini support, including Gemini Flash models that work well on the free Gemini API tier for most everyday form-design tasks. Build multi-page wizards, publish multilingual experiences, accept payments, manage submissions, and automate work with approvals, email, webhooks, retry history, and C# after-submission actions. Sales and support: daoa@dnndefender.com.
